title: Scoring crash window: a crash between update_streak (streak.json) and the terminal pick save lets the restarted scorer apply the same result again
tier_reason: a double application changes local streak/saver state until the 02:00 replay heals it (a hit counts twice; a saver-consuming miss re-applied without the saver resets to 0, by code reading); unfixed (deferred); B -> A

contract.text: One result affects the streak and the saver at most once, including the saver case, across a crash and restart between the streak update and the terminal pick write.

mechanism.text: check_results and run_result_polling call update_streak (writes streak.json) and then save_pick (writes the terminal result) inside scoring_lock; the two files are written separately, so a crash in between leaves streak.json advanced and the pick unresolved, and the restarted scorer re-reads the pick as unscored and applies update_streak again

residual.text: Deferred: the two-file streak+pick atomicity journal; healed by the 02:00 season replay and contest anchoring (the decision streak is the contest value), so the window affects local state until the next replay
residual.source: 49f2538 body ('Deferred (with rationale): two-file streak+pick atomicity journal'); ARCHITECTURE.md 'Scoring serialization' known deferral

watchdog.trigger: after each scoring run, the streak.json change for a date differs from the single application implied by that date's terminal result, or a date is scored twice
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the replayed season streak and saver equal streak.json after the next reconcile

evidence.what: 'update-streak-then-save crash window can double-count a day (cli.py:1759 / scheduler.py:1384)'
'Deferred (with rationale): two-file streak+pick atomicity journal (pre-existing, healed by reconcile + contest anchoring)'
'Known deferral: streak.json + pick-file remain a two-file non-atomic pair under crash (healed by the 2am replay + contest anchoring)'

evidence.locator: src/bts/cli.py check_results and src/bts/scheduler.py run_result_polling at 4490aee
evidence.what: update_streak precedes save_pick inside the lock at every scoring site; a peer-scored check only protects against a completed save
every install in the continuous logged chain 7/02 -> 9/22 (last: 4490aee) carries the two-file write; no fix exists

notes: scoring_lock (3a09b2c/49f2538, I-073 F13) serializes concurrent scorers but does not make the two writes atomic
healing depends on the 02:00 replay, which has its own same-day rollback defect (I-202)
a firing would show as a scheduler restart during result polling or check-results followed by a streak.json jump; Route R (journals from 5/11, cron.log)
fixtures: filled from Task 5/6 acceptance objects at build time
fixtures built 2026-09-29 (plan Task 1), three strict expected failures:

- the real `bts check-results` dying at the terminal pick save then restarted: a hit counts twice (5 -> 7), and a saver-absorbed miss re-applied without the saver resets 12 -> 0 (this executes the saver-case consequence);
- the daemon's run_result_polling dying at the same point, then the 01:00 check-results re-applying the hit (5 -> 7).

All three fail unmarked with ResultAppliedTwice. A simulated repair that saves the pick before the streak turns each node XPASS(strict): the reorder in check_results for the two CLI nodes, and in run_result_polling for the polling node. A no-fault control applies once.
